title: Reporter Goddess Anggraini was charged with spreading false news
paragraphs: News reporter Mining, Goddess Anggraini, was charged with exposure to a false rumor related to a nickel mining permit.
According to the charges, Goddess Anggraini published a report about the license of the nickel mines on October 5, 2025, which the prosecutor judged to broadcast a lie.
The indictment was read at the Hammer Court on December 10, 2025, the first hearing of the witness was scheduled on January 14, 2026.
In the matter of Goddess Anggraini, Rina Susanti's legal power said the plea for the defense to have the judge replaced was rejected by the council.
The Goddess of Agraini working as a reporter for the News of Mine at Hammer, a journalist's organization assessing that this case could have a lesson in press freedom.
The threat of punishment for this chapter is up to 10 years in prison, the Goddess Anggraini is not under arrest during the trial.
